metadata.title: टोना- टोटका और हत्या का सिलसिला  | Tribal Bulletin
metadata.description: In today’s bulletin, we will discuss the issue of superstition-related murders occurring every third day in Chhattisgarh. Then, we’ll look into the government's plan to collect fees from tribal students. After that, we’ll share the inspiring success story of a girl from a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) in Odisha. Finally, we’ll dive into the ongoing debate on "Adivasi" versus "Vanavasi" identity.
